q: The KAM (Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser) theorem guarantees persistence of quasi-periodic invariant tori in near-integrable Hamiltonian systems when the frequency vector ω satisfies:
opts: ω satisfies a Diophantine condition |k·ω| ≥ γ|k|⁻τ for all k ∈ ℤⁿ\{0}
exp: KAM tori persist for Diophantine frequency vectors (small divisors controlled by γ and τ). Resonant (rational ω) and Liouville tori are destroyed. The measure of surviving tori is large for small perturbations.
